registered_before: any ConceptNet download, any import-route measurement, any reading of ConceptNet ja content beyond knowing it exists
structure: isolated sovereign (CrossStore sidecar), NEVER in census, hand-off only, every answer carries source label conceptnet5.7 and the relation name

adopt_if.note: correct >= 2x baseline AND wrong <= 2. 誤答 is the enemy: a wrong assertion from an imported KB is worse than silence because it wears a source label.

park_if: anything else — the sovereign stays built but wired to nothing, verdict burned into the commit like W3a
scoring: identical to measure_commonsense_baseline.py: ANSWERED_CORRECT if an axis token (or the property) appears in the route's answer; TYPED_REFUSAL for typed silence; WRONG for an asserting answer without the axis
not_allowed: moving these thresholds after any import measurement
letting the imported sovereign vote in any census
